plugin.name: Deadline Buddy
plugin.description: Keep manual deadlines and selected Google Calendar or Outlook events close at hand.
config.reminderOffsets.label: Deadline reminders
config.reminderOffsets.description: Choose when to be reminded before each deadline. Clear all choices to turn off scheduled reminders.
config.snoozeMinutes.label: Snooze duration
config.snoozeMinutes.description: How long to wait when you snooze an alert. Each alert can be snoozed up to three times.
config.soundEnabled.label: Play an alert sound
config.soundEnabled.description: Play a sound when a deadline alert appears.
config.customSound.label: Custom alert sound
config.customSound.description: Optional sound to use instead of the default alert sound.
config.osNotification.label: Show a desktop notification
config.osNotification.description: Also send an operating-system notification when a deadline alert appears.
command.add.title: Add deadline…
command.add.description: Create a personal deadline using your computer's local time.
command.list.title: List deadlines
command.list.description: Hear the nearest active manual deadlines and tracked calendar events.
command.manage.title: Manage manual deadlines…
command.manage.description: Complete, delete, rename, or reschedule a manual deadline.
command.connectGoogle.title: Connect Google Calendar
command.connectGoogle.description: Connect a Google account using Composio's managed sign-in flow.
command.connectOutlook.title: Connect Outlook Calendar
command.connectOutlook.description: Connect a Microsoft account using Composio's managed sign-in flow.
command.disconnectGoogle.title: Disconnect Google Calendar
command.disconnectGoogle.description: Remove this local profile's Google Calendar connection.
command.disconnectOutlook.title: Disconnect Outlook Calendar
command.disconnectOutlook.description: Remove this local profile's Outlook Calendar connection.
command.refreshCalendars.title: Refresh calendar list
command.refreshCalendars.description: Refresh connected calendars and add event-browsing commands.
command.checkConnections.title: Check calendar connections
command.checkConnections.description: Show Google and Outlook connection status for this local profile.
command.browseCalendar.title: Browse events in a calendar…
command.browseCalendar.description: Choose a future event in this calendar to track as a deadline.
command.trackEvents.title: Track an event…
command.trackEvents.description: Select one upcoming event from this calendar.
command.sync.title: Sync tracked events now
command.sync.description: Check tracked calendar events for time changes or cancellation.
command.snooze.title: Snooze latest alert
command.snooze.description: Snooze the most recent active deadline alert.
command.dismiss.title: Dismiss latest alert
command.dismiss.description: Dismiss the most recent active deadline alert.
command.retry.title: Retry failed alerts
command.retry.description: Retry deadline alerts that could not be shown after bounded automatic attempts.
